input.title: Men's Dirt Bike – Full Send. Mostly Mud. Hoodie
input.descriptionHtml:
The Story

FULL SEND. MOSTLY MUD. is the dirt bike hoodie for the rider who planned a clean jump and landed in the puddle, worn at the track, on the trail ride and in the garage while the gear dries.

FULL SEND. runs across the top in tall condensed capitals and MOSTLY MUD. fills the bottom, even wider. Between them a rider in a helmet and goggles, splattered from helmet to boots, lands a vintage motocross bike in a puddle while a wave of mud sprays up around the front wheel.

Navy carries cream and mustard lettering with a cream edge around the mud scene; Sand gets dark brown and deep rust lettering. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit, pullover with a double-lined hood and matching drawcord
  • 50% pre-shrunk cotton, 50% polyester
  • Fabric weight: 8.0 oz/yd²
  • Air-jet spun yarn with a soft feel
  • Front pouch pocket, ribbed cuffs and waistband with spandex
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • Colors: Sand, Navy
  • Blank product sourced from Bangladesh, Nicaragua, Honduras or El Salvador

Questions

Is this dirt bike hoodie warm enough for cold rides and garage days?
Yes. The Full Send. Mostly Mud. hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a Gildan 18500 pullover in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, with a double-lined hood and a front pouch pocket. It is an easy layer for cold mornings at the track, the trailhead and the garage.

How does the Full Send. Mostly Mud. hoodie fit?
It is a classic unisex cut in adult sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for a regular fit, or go up one for a roomier layer over a riding jersey or work shirt. If it is not right, Graphic Tees Co. offers a free size exchange, so the first pick carries no risk.

Is this a good gift for a dirt bike rider?
It is a natural one. Every rider has planned a clean jump and ended up in the puddle, so it lands with riding buddies and the family who washes the gear. It comes in Sand and Navy, prints to order, and the free size exchange covers a wrong guess on size.

How do I wash the hoodie so the print lasts?
Turn the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie inside out, wash it in cold water with similar colors and tumble dry on low. Skip bleach and ironing on the print. The design is printed directly on the fabric, so gentle care keeps the lettering and the mud splash sharp wash after wash.

When should I order for Christmas delivery?
Order by about December 8 to have the Full Send. Mostly Mud. hoodie for Christmas. Each Graphic Tees Co. hoodie is printed to order after you buy, and shipping is free on orders over $45. Orders placed after that date may arrive after the holiday, so earlier is safer.
